messages:
jess: FYI seeing weird packing holes in apse1 this morning. lots of tiny GPUs (dev/test) parked on warm nodes and reserved racks have isolated free GPUs.
marco: Yep saw that too. packing fragmentation jumped and preemptions for reserved workloads spiked. Feels like the warm-node autoscaler filled with small VMs that don't match our 'rack' locality constraints.
infra-bot: METRIC: apse1.packing.fragmentation=0.29 (5m), reserved_preempts=47/1h, warmpool_fill=high. Link: https://metrics.redwood/apse1/packing
tanya: Quick logs show scheduler scored nodes weirdly because of a new node-labeling job last night. Some warm nodes got label rack=unused instead of rack=reserved, so scoring preferred them for small pods.
devon: sample filter: ```E18:21 scheduler: pod/model-sm filtered nodes: node-88 rejected (label mismatch: required rack in [reserved], node has rack=unused)```
sree: If small pods land on warm nodes that are spread across racks, we get many single-GPU leftovers on reserved racks which blocks packing for multi-GPU reserved jobs. That drives cross-rack allocation and preemptions.
jess: short-term: (1) add alias to scheduler label matcher to accept rack values {reserved, reserved-old} for existing affinity; (2) temporarily taint warm nodes with taint warm=true:NoSchedule for reserved-class pods; (3) trigger a controlled defrag by cordoning the smallest warm nodes and letting scheduler binpack.
marco: I'll push the alias hotfix (config change) and hot-reload scheduler. tanya, can you apply the taint to warm-nodes-asg in apse1 for 20m window?
tanya: On it. Applying taint now to asg/warm-apse1. Watching for fallout.
infra-bot: ACTION: applied taint warm=true to warm-node ASG apse1 at 2025-11-12T18:25:03Z. Notifying oncall.
devon: after taint, small pods should avoid warm nodes; but we might see scale-downs. I've queued a cautious defrag job: drain 4 warm nodes at a time, wait 5m for steady state, then proceed.
sree: Important: watch attach-controller queue while draining. If we cause many re-attaches, we can trigger an attach retry spiral. Set concurrent_attach limit to 60 during drains.
jess: Agree. Also enable placement_grace window of 10m so in-flight reschedules don't cascade.
marco: Canary alias config applied in apse1a, rejects dropped from 12% -> 0.5% in 8m. Rolling to rest of apse1.
tanya: Taint applied and defrag started (phase 1). Monitoring: attach-controller.queue=22, median_attach_latency=28s.
infra-bot: NOTE: defrag.phase1 complete: 4 nodes drained, binpack efficiency improved. apse1.fragmentation=0.17.
sree: postmortem items: add label-consistency check to CI, alert on sudden warmpool_label_changes, and add a safety gate to autoscaler to avoid adding nodes with rack=unused. Also add metric warmnode_taint_uses.
jess: cost note: fragmentation was costing ~10% wasted reserved GPU capacity in apse1 (~$24k/month). adding to ticket.
marco: Follow-ups: (1) add alias-unit-tests to scheduler CI, (2) audit last-night relabel job, (3) add attach-controller backpressure knob to runbook.
jess: thanks all 44d will file INFRA-8892 and link runbook. Closing loop when defrag fully done. :white_check_mark:
